spec.name: Furniture Pumpkin String Lights
spec.description: Three small orange jack-o-lantern bulbs hang from a stepped charcoal cord with two ceiling attachments reaching y=15.75. The center bulb hangs lower, and each pumpkin has a distinct painted glowing grin. Connected, axis-aligned furniture with no ground support.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: ceiling-hung strand of three small orange jack-o-lantern bulbs on a dark stepped cord, each with a different glowing grin, attached at both upper ends; no posts or floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Ceiling attachment: suspension points reach y=15.75, artwork hanging below. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
